description: SYNTHETIC: generated by src/recon/generator.py. One row per webhook delivery that arrived on _arrival_date (UTC).

fields.name: delivery_id
fields.description: One delivery attempt: dlv_<event_id>_<attempt>. Unique per row.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: The webhook event: evt_<payment_id>_cap. The same on every redelivery. The dedup key.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: payment.captured, the only type in v1.0.

fields.name: payment_id
fields.description: PSP payment reference shared with the statement: pay_<yyyymmdd>_<tag>_<nnnnn>.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: Our order id: ord_<yyyymmdd>_<tag>_<nnnnn>. Not used for matching in v1.0.

fields.name: amount_minor
fields.description: Captured amount in minor units of currency. Never a float.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code, equal to the MID currency.

fields.name: delivered_ts
fields.description: When our backend received this delivery, UTC, whole seconds. DATE(delivered_ts) = _arrival_date.

fields.name: _arrival_date
fields.description: Partition column: the UTC day this delivery arrived. One run owns one arrival date.

fields.name: _source_file
fields.description: Landing file path, relative to the landing folder.
